title: Quantum state texture of dynamical criticality
summary: We investigate the role of quantum state texture in dynamical quantum phase transitions by establishing a direct connection between critical nonequilibrium dynamics and the recently introduced notion of rugosity, a measure of quantum state texture. Considering a generic quench protocol, we analyze both standard formulations of dynamical quantum phase transitions.
